note: The Reserve Bank's Commercial Banks – Credit Information Reporting Directions, 2025: banks report as on the 9th, 16th, 23rd and last day of each month, overdue accounts among them, within four days (the month-end file by the 5th), so an overdue payment reaches the bureaus within 12 days at most (the 8 days from the 1st to the 9th and the 4 to submit), written as 12. The Credit Information Companies Regulations, 2006, as CRIF High Mark publishes them: credit information is kept at least seven years, written as seven.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Credit Information Reporting) Directions, 2025 (updated as on July 01, 2026)
sources.said: (i) A CI shall submit credit information as on 9th, 16th, 23rd and last day of the month (hereinafter referred to as the reference dates) to CICs. ... A CI shall submit the full file containing credit information records as on the last day of the month to the CICs, by 5th day of the next month. ... The CI shall submit such credit information to CICs within four (4) calendar days from the above-mentioned dates. ... (d) Accounts where interest and / or instalment of principal is overdue

sources.title: CRIF High Mark, Credit Information Companies Rules and Regulations, 2006
sources.said: retain credit information collected, maintained and disseminated by them for a minimum period of seven years.
